detail.longDescription: If AI agents write more of our code, should we change how we structure it? I wrote about modularity as a way to limit context, the value of human-readable code when agents get stuck, and whether we need new design patterns for agentic development. More questions than answers, but questions worth asking. https:// michalcichon.github.io/program ming/2026/11/10/design-patterns-and-code-quality-in-the-era-of-ai.html # AI # SoftwareEngineering # Programming
